notes.title: 24 OCT 2021 - New Input System and Controller Calibration
notes.content:
24 OCT 2021 - PATCH

The input system is completely rewritten to use a newer input system that should support all the headsets and controller setups better. There's also a controller calibration which you can find in the Menu -> Controller Calibration page. Place your hands on the boxes where you want think the controller _should_ be, and press trigger. It will save the rotation adjustment to your local settings.

CHANGES

 rewrite input for better controller support
 added controller rotation calibration
 adjusted material used for controllers


KNOWN ISSUES

 menu draws on top of controllers
 puzzle pieces can get stuck in tables sometimes

Patch Notes (October 10th, 2021)

 removed auto-swap handling of xr/fps modes (stays in VR now, toggle with 'backspace'), this should fix steamvr overlay issue
 adjusted brightness
 adjusted menu materials slightly (is still temporary design)
 demo build now only starts timer when puzzle is created


Let me know if you have any further issues, or post in the forums. I don't have all the VR headsets so let me know what setup you're using if you have some problems!

notes.title: Puzzle Cafe VR - Now On Sale!
notes.content:
Puzzle Cafe VR is now live on Steam. Try the demo, buy the game, and enjoy some relaxing VR jigsaw puzzles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40860140/d1309eb9ebaf442b711b94f56d7f5cba0a03a088.gif

 The game is early access, so please share your feedback in the Steam Forums. 

How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?
“There will be a lot of experimenting based on early feedback, so the feature set is not entirely set in stone out but you can expect:

- more puzzles artworks
- more puzzle shapes and styles
- more cafe decorations
- more game modes / challenges
- quality of life improvements
- improved visuals for high end PC specs

Thanks!
